downloadText: Download while the system keeps running. The full backup contains the database, all media, fonts and the server keys (players stay paired after a restore). Keep it safe.
pendingText: The checked backup is applied when the server restarts.
restartConfirm: Restart the server now? The web interface is unavailable for a few seconds; screens keep playing.
restoreConfirm: Prepare the restore from “{name}”? Nothing changes until the restart.
restoreText: Upload a full backup (.tar) or a database backup (.db). The file is checked first; it is applied with a controlled restart. The current state is kept with a timestamp.
staged: The backup was checked and is ready. Restart to apply it.
title: Backup
